// Compute 3D conformational properties from a multi-conformer ensemble. type get_3d_properties = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Find the most similar molecules from the training set using task-aware embeddings.
